checks.name: Adversarial cross-check of asserted behaviour against accepted production
checks.method: Read `stimulation_actions.hpp`/`.cpp` and `stimulation_journal.hpp`/`.cpp` in full and traced each asserted status/count back to the implementation path (precondition order, guard-once call site, non-mutating `precheck`, journal-before-emission ordering, `append_frame_locked` truncate-on-failure, completion outcome derivation).
checks.result: pass: the tests assert real fail-closed behaviour of the accepted surfaces, not restated constants. The guard is evaluated once per request (`stimulation_actions.cpp:540`, no other `authorize` site); the lease is prechecked without mutation before the guard and acquired only after authorization (`:524,556`); the durable intent is committed before the seam and the outcome after (`stimulation_journal.cpp:909-945`); a failed append restores the prior offset (`append_frame_locked`); and every completion decline returns the exact declared `CompletionOutcome` (`:660-873`).

non_blocking_observations.observation: The 'exactly one accepted guard evaluation per request' property is not asserted on the action path itself, because `StimulationActionPath` owns its `StimulationGuard` privately with no snapshot accessor. `T29-TS-001` proves the property on a directly constructed accepted guard (`guard.snapshot().evaluations` increments once per `authorize`) and relies on the source inspection that the action path calls `authorize` exactly once per request (`src/xverse/xcom/src/stimulation_actions.cpp:540`). Verification-plan CHK-15 is worded more strongly ('every mismatch row asserts exactly one accepted guard evaluation per submitted request') than the realized evidence.
non_blocking_observations.assessment: Honest and sufficient for the accepted surface, and explicitly recorded rather than over-claimed; not a behavioural defect. Recorded so CHK-15 is not over-read as an action-path-internal counter assertion.

non_blocking_observations.observation: A conflict-family lease decline through the registry (`Conflict`/`SessionMismatch`/`GenerationMismatch`/`PlanMismatch`) advances the declared registry `conflicts` counter, so `T29-TS-016` asserts the active set and acquisition count are unchanged plus the expected counter delta rather than whole-snapshot equality. Declines driven through the action path use the non-mutating `precheck`, so `T29-TS-016` and `T29-TS-011` Z-06 can assert whole-snapshot equality there.
non_blocking_observations.assessment: Matches the accepted registry semantics (counters are declared observability, not lease entries); no behavioural defect.

summary: Verdict pass. The T029 candidate is well-scoped, additive, test-only, offline, deterministic, and linear over baseline 4d3985855ef7a62b68aa4c66d3b7df032b29f5e9. The recomputed inventory is exactly the 20 paths in `reviewed_paths`; the deterministic gate reports `changed_paths: 20` and `ctest:387`; the six t029-* suites run 20/20 green (5/5/1/4/3/2 by label, discovery 367 -> 387); the full suite is 387/387 with the preserved T026-T029 suites at 81/81; the four register validators pass; and every recorded digest (tests, fixture, build file, `links.json`, stage results, work products) matches its file content. Reading the accepted T025-T028 production confirms the passing assertions exercise real fail-closed behaviour: single guard evaluation, non-mutating lease precheck, journal-before-emission with truncate-on-failure atomicity, restart-recovered orphan identity, exclusive single-winner lease races, and terminal completion that never reports an orphan as `Closed`. No production byte, existing test, accepted requirement, ADR, contract, or register is weakened, and no T030+ artifact is present. No blocking finding remains; six informational observations are recorded (guard-count evidence strength, conflict-counter semantics, test-local identity projection, vestigial T029 compile definitions, the inherited gate-command absolute path, and a per-case operation-count wording imprecision). This review is read-only and does not accept or integrate the candidate; external Codex review and user acceptance remain deferred until the ordered backlog xcom-t026-t029-20260928 completes.
